encoding.scheme: vertex i -> random code word O_i; edge i->j -> the 3' half of O_i followed by the 5' half of O_j (all of O_i when i = v_in, all of O_j when j = v_out); the complement Obar_i splints the junction at vertex i

analysis.algorithm: 1 ligate random paths; 2 keep the paths from v_in to v_out; 3 keep the paths with exactly n vertices; 4 keep the paths that enter every vertex; 5 read out what is left

steps.detail: edge oligonucleotides joined by the vertex splints
excise the 140 bp band = 20-mer code words x 7 vertices
successive capture on biotinylated Obar1, Obar2, Obar3, Obar4, Obar5
one band per vertex slot at 20 (k+1) bp

experiment.ligation: 50 pmol of each oligonucleotide, 5 units T4 DNA ligase, 4 hours at room temperature in 100 ul
experiment.pcr: 35 cycles of 94 C 15 s / 30 C 60 s; graduated PCR 25 cycles at 40 C
experiment.gel: 3% or 5% agarose in TBE with ethidium bromide
experiment.beads: biotinylated splints on streptavidin paramagnetic particles
experiment.scaling: the copies needed grow exponentially with the number of vertices; Hartmanis (1995) put a 200-city instance at more than the weight of the Earth in DNA
